breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained two redundant lines specifying the time integration method: 'time_integration: Explicit forward Euler' and 'time_integration: Forward Euler with dt small enough for stability'. The ground truth removed the first, redundant line. The agent successfully resolved this by consolidating the instructions and mentioning the 'Forward Euler' method only once, thus removing the conflict/redundancy.
